Welcome to We Love Animals — we share animal rescue stories, incredible wildlife encounters, and inspiring pet adoption stories from around the world.

We believe every animal deserves kindness and compassion. From dog and cat rescue videos to amazing wildlife footage and rehabilitation stories — we share the moments that remind us why animals make the world a better place.

We talk to animal heroes that have dedicated their lives to animal welfare. We tell stories about rehabilitation, adoption, fostering, and rescue. 

We Love Animals is part of Newsner, a global digital news platform.

Follow us on:
📘 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/TheAnimalClub.net
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/weloveanimals_newsner/
🎶 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@weloveanimals_official

We love animals! ❤️ 🐾
